task.description: Rework iteration 1: fix step-02c's INV-8 BLOCKER -- config_from_snapshot/1 (and its route_kind_atom/1, method_from_snapshot/1 helpers) can raise on malformed stored config_snapshot data, crashing the shared Poller GenServer. Give both helpers explicit catch-all clauses returning typed {:error, ...}; make config_from_snapshot/1 return {:ok, Config.t()} | {:error, atom()}; wrap attempt_dispatch/2 in an outer try/rescue mirroring Letflow.Scheduler.attempt_fire/2's exact shape. Add regression tests.

result.summary: RECONSTRUCTED HANDOFF -- written 2026-09-03 after the fact from the run's real, on-disk state (the current service_task_dispatcher.ex file, independently read at reconstruction time, contains exactly this fix with an inline comment attributing it to 'BLOCKER fix (SECURITY-REVIEWER, queue task 415)'); timestamps are reconstructed approximations. route_kind_atom/1 given a catch-all clause: route_kind_atom(_other), do: {:error, :invalid_route_kind} (confirmed present, alongside the two real clauses for "inline_url" and "catalog_service"). method_from_snapshot/1 given a catch-all clause: method_from_snapshot(_other), do: {:error, :invalid_method} (confirmed present, alongside the five real HTTP-verb clauses). config_from_snapshot/1's @spec confirmed updated to {:ok, ServiceTask.Config.t()} | {:error, :invalid_route_kind | :invalid_method}, built via a with-chain over both helpers so either failure short-circuits to a typed error tuple rather than a raise. do_attempt_dispatch/2 confirmed to carry a new {:error, _malformed_reason} case clause routing a malformed snapshot through handle_failure/4 with failure_kind :request_build_error (the same failure_kind design §5.2/§5.6 already define for a request that could never be built) -- reading retry_limit directly from the raw snapshot map, since it does not depend on route_kind/method having parsed successfully. attempt_dispatch/2 confirmed to now wrap its entire Repo.transaction/1 call in an outer try/rescue that converts any exception to {:error, {:raised, exception}} -- read directly against Letflow.Scheduler.attempt_fire/2 (lib/letflow/scheduler.ex) at reconstruction time and confirmed to be the identical shape: a bare try/rescue around the transaction call, the rescue clause producing the same {:error, {:raised, exception}} tuple. This backfill independently confirmed all four changes are present in the current file; it cannot recover this specific rework session's own test-run transcript, but 3 regression tests are present in test/letflow/engine/service_task_dispatcher_test.exs covering this exact class (a malformed route_kind, a malformed method, and confirmation that neither raises past config_from_snapshot/1), consistent with the task's own instruction to add regression coverage.
